classification_definitions.maintenance_status: Disposition of the selected source/edition, not a publication acceptance. maintained may have old constituent fields; superseded_snapshot means selected edition is behind an identified maintained successor; retired means producer retirement is evidenced; intentional_reference means fixed temporal/product scope; maintenance_unverified preserves uncertainty; parked means unconditional source refusal already contains the issue.
classification_definitions.discovery_mode: Separate adapter behavior. Fixed source counts/content pins are not evidence producer stopped maintenance. Schema checks alone are not classified as fixed-population gates.
classification_definitions.runtime_state: Fetch-enabled means an HTTP path exists after documented config/resource guards; it does not mean schedules are enabled or a live run succeeded. local_only means supplied inputs without acquisition; registered_refuses means unconditional parked source guard.
classification_definitions.crosswalk_actual_comparison: Normalized URL relationship only; different endpoints can be justified current producer routes or partial successor products. Read per-row evidence.
classification_definitions.latest_selection_verified: True only for audited latest-release resolvers; live mutable capture may not need an edition resolver but still needs currentness evidence.
